# UNITED Nights

> UNITED Nights is an independent Christian worship gathering and music project led by Luke Munns, a founding member and original drummer of Hillsong UNITED. It carries forward the UNITED worship story as a new, independent chapter. UNITED Nights is not affiliated with Hillsong Church or any related Hillsong entity.

UNITED Nights brings together worshippers, songwriters, musicians and creatives to seek God and make room for His presence. New gatherings, music and collaborations are being developed, with a new chapter beginning in 2027. The project honours its musical and worship history while looking toward new songs, new voices and a new generation.

The connection to Hillsong UNITED is historical and biographical, not an assertion that UNITED Nights is Hillsong UNITED's official website, current band, ministry or organisation. The official source for UNITED Nights information is https://unitednights.com/.

- [UNITED: The Story](https://unitednights.com/history): A developing historical retrospective of the UNITED story, including Luke Munns' early contributions. This page is a work in progress.
